escalation.suspected_cause: Third-party payments provider is under scheduled maintenance (ETA unknown); our connector is running and healthy but every charge is refused with 503.
escalation.evidence: payments log: "charge refused: provider-side scheduled maintenance in progress" (POST /charge 503). shop log: "payment rejected (HTTP 503): provider_maintenance ... ETA unknown". Smoke: 4/5 pass; checkout fails with 502 payment_failed upstream 503. Both services running; health, catalog, latency and stats_integrity pass.
escalation.actions_taken: Diagnosis only: smoke tests, service status, payments and shop logs. No changes made, since restarting the connector or changing the token cannot fix a provider outage.
escalation.recommended_next_step: Contact the payments vendor for the maintenance window and ETA. Consider a customer-facing notice or a checkout maintenance banner (a business decision). After the provider recovers, re-run run_smoke_tests to confirm checkout returns 201 and that orders are persisted.
